primary_task: Make the user's local or Blob documents searchable by creating a Foundry IQ knowledge base (knowledge source + Azure AI Search service) and validating retrieval.

requirements.name: azure
requirements.evidence: compatibility: Azure ... create/reuse a Search service ... Before expensive service discovery, reuse supplied resource/intent; otherwise ask one early **USE EXISTING / FIND CANDIDATES / CREATE NEW** choice.
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, ...)"

requirements.name: management.azure.com (Azure / Foundry endpoints)
requirements.evidence: If existing-KB connection versus KB creation/reconfiguration is unclear, read intent-routing and clarify that scope before Azure discovery. | Searchable/KB | [KB](knowledge-bases/create.md) |
requirements.basis: egress_deny: "*.azure.com"; lacks: "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: ... Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints"

requirements.name: Azure AI Search service (*.search.windows.net)
requirements.evidence: Searchable docs: KB + validated retrieval. ... | Search only | [Search](search-services/create.md) |
requirements.basis: egress_allow does not list search.windows.net; description: "other hosts are refused"

requirements.name: skill procedure files (knowledge-bases/create.md, references/intent-routing.md, etc.)
requirements.evidence: Read one procedure before questions/actions; invocation is not a read.
requirements.basis: tools.skill: "load an installed Claude Code skill"; the manifest does not say whether the bundled procedures are installed.

notes: Every operation in the routing table (create KB, query KB, connect agent, diagnose, cleanup) targets Azure resources, so no reading of the document avoids Azure. Even the read-only 'Read KB' path needs Azure access and credentials.
